title: Review: Control Flow
concept: Choose the right control flow tool: if for conditions, while/for for repetition, match for multi-way branching.
why: Every program needs control flow. Knowing which tool fits which job makes your code cleaner and more correct.
tips: `for` for counted or collection iteration; `while` for condition-based
`match` for dispatching on values; `if` for complex conditions
`break` exits the loop; `continue` skips to the next iteration
Use the simplest tool that does the job — don't over-engineer
common_mistakes: Using `while` when `for` would be cleaner and safer
Using `if/elif` chains when `match` would be more readable
Forgetting that `for` loop variable is immutable
